b0_reference.interpretation: fixed full-depth reference using the same ViT P0 checkpoint and held-out head results

methods: P0 — LatentWave with Post-hoc Frozen Early Exits
C0 — CNN Original L8 JEPA Objective
provenance_note: C0 was trained directly with a deterministic 90/10 pretraining split and validation-loss early stopping (100-epoch maximum); its planned five-epoch full-data prefix was explicitly skipped. C2 reuses its already-trained frozen heads and matching epoch-69 checkpoint (pretraining validation loss 0.466410); only its missing held-out test evaluation and inference benchmark are added. A later C2 continuation reached a better epoch-93 pretraining checkpoint (validation loss 0.431457), but its heads were not retrained on that checkpoint and it is not the C2 representation evaluated in this report. Training histories differ; all results are seed-0 descriptive comparisons.
